items.title: Ralph LaLama interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 23, 2010
items.q: Yeah, because that’s my influence. ... I was always towards the Sonny thing. ... I was trying to play like Sonny

ctx.x: I would probably have to say Sonny Rollins and Hank Mobley.
Well you know it’s interesting because the guy who wrote the entry for the Grove Encyclopedia of Jazz said exactly that.
